# documentdb

DocumentDB as MongoDB-compatible access plus AWS cluster posture (storage encryption, backup) measured from dumps.

## Rules

| Rule | Severity | Title |
|---|---|---|
| `AF-DATA-011` | medium | MongoDB find/aggregate without a limit |
| `AF-DATA-012` | critical | MongoDB filtered write with an empty filter |
| `AF-STORE-003` | critical | DocumentDB cluster storage is not encrypted |
